pins.name: D7
pins.label: GPIO7 (Button)
pins.notes: PIN_BUTTON / BOOT — onboard bootloader-select pushbutton, also usable as a general input when application code is running. Active-low with the RP2040's internal pull-up enabled (no external pull-up on this line). Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_adalogger_rp2040.dts gpio_keys node (gpios = <&gpio0 7 (GPIO_ACTIVE_LOW | GPIO_PULL_UP)>) and Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("The Boot button is the button on the right, located on GPIO7"). Full digital_input/digital_output/pwm_output capability retained (ordinary GPIO wired to a switch to GND, not a dedicated/capacitive-only pin), matching this repo's adafruit_feather_scorpio PIN_BUTTON precedent.

pins.name: D13
pins.label: GPIO13 (Led active high)
pins.notes: PIN_LED — onboard status LED (D13), active-high. Confirmed via Zephyr's adafruit_feather_adalogger_rp2040.dts leds node (gpios = <&gpio0 13 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>) and Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("Above the USB C connector is the D13 LED... controllable... as PIN_LED"). digital_input dropped to match this repo's established led_high precedent for dedicated onboard LED pins (rpipico, adafruit_feather_scorpio, adafruit_metro); pwm_output kept since arduino-pico's analogWrite() works on any RP2040 GPIO, enabling brightness dimming. This GPIO was also the vendor's default (unused) PIN_SPI0_SS alias, which would have contaminated this confirmed LED tag with a spurious spi_ss capability — fixed 2026-07-13 by removing that alias (and its dependent `static const uint8_t SS` line) from pins_arduino.h, confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide stating there is no dedicated CS pin on the main SPI header (GPIO13 was merely one of several arbitrary software-selectable SS choices), matching the adafruit_feather_scorpio bus-alias-contamination fix pattern.

pins.name: GPIO16
pins.label: GPIO16
pins.notes:
PIN_CARD_DETECT — onboard microSD card connector's card-presence-detect switch. digital_output/pwm_output dropped: it's a mechanical switch to GND/logic level, so driving this pin as an output could conflict with the socket's own switch state. digital_input retained since reading card presence is a genuine, safe, useful operation. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("SD_CARD_DETECT/GPIO16") and CircuitPython mpconfigboard.h (card detect on GPIO16, default state card-inserted=true), matching this repo's solderparty_rp2350_stamp PIN_CARD_DETECT precedent.
Check if available on board

pins.name: D17
pins.label: GPIO17 (Led Neopixel)
pins.notes: PIN_NEOPIXEL — onboard single status NeoPixel (WS2812), output-only data line. Confirmed via Adafruit's own pinouts guide ("Above the silkscreen label for pin 24 is the status NeoPixel LED. It is connected to GPIO17"), Zephyr's adafruit_feather_adalogger_rp2040.dts ws2812 node (gpios = <&gpio0 17 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>, chain-length = <1>, confirming a single pixel not a chain), and CircuitPython mpconfigboard.h (MICROPY_HW_NEOPIXEL -> GPIO17).

pins.name: GPIO18
pins.label: GPIO18
pins.notes:
PIN_SD_CLK / PIN_SPI1_SCK — onboard microSD card connector's dedicated SPI1 clock line. Not general-purpose. Confirmed via Adafruit's pinouts guide ("SD_SCK/GPIO18") and CircuitPython mpconfigboard.h. spi_sck capability is auto-supplied by build_boards.js from this board's SPI1 SCK alias, matching this repo's sparkfun_thingplusrp2040/solderparty_rp2350_stamp SD-card exclusion precedent.

pins.name: GPIO21
pins.label: GPIO21
pins.notes:
PIN_SD_DAT1 — onboard microSD card connector's dedicated 4-bit-SDIO DAT1 line (unused in the default 1-bit SPI mode this core uses, but still physically dedicated to the card socket). Not general-purpose. No SPI-role alias in pins_arduino.h, so no bus-role tag applies either, matching this repo's sparkfun_thingplusrp2040 D10/D11 precedent.
